name: AMD
rationale: Committed $1B alongside NVIDIA's $3B into Meta's Oct 26 2026 equity offering (Broadcom also expressed non-binding interest in the same raise). AMD is increasingly deploying balance-sheet capital into AI-compute-adjacent equity stakes (also holds warrants toward ~10% of Meta via its Feb 2026 chip supply deal) - worth tracking as a corporate allocator alongside the existing hyperscaler/silicon watchlist.
